title: Spinach: modeled ₹389/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: January 2025: reported spinach prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 81% of 26 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹389 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 176 same-variety market pairs screened for spinach in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported spinach prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 26 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹1,500 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹1,838 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹475/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹475 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 92% of days.

scenes.headline: 150 km by road
scenes.caption: 150 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹32/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹301 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹177 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 21 of 26 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹389 per quintal (₹289 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Spinach route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 81% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹38,900, or ₹28,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to spinach
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹32/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Spinach route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 81% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹38,900, or ₹28,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
